thread:
maya: Quick check — ran a lightweight scout on a new candidate (argus-lite-11b) with static int8. High-level: token cost down a lot, small fidelity blips on a couple GTN slices. Posting the short numbers and a tiny routing sim.

sam: drop the raw numbers? which quant pipeline (per-channel/static/dynamic)?

maya: static int8 with per-channel scaling (our usual). Slices tested: gtn-helpdesk, summarize-long, code-complete. TL;DR: helpdesk accuracy -0.8pp, summarize-long ROUGE-L -1.5pp, code top1 ~0 diff. P95 latency baseline fp16 220ms -> int8 248ms.

olivia: unit econ please — what does this mean $/1k tokens?

maya: baseline fp16 ~ $0.32 / 1k tokens, int8 ~ $0.19 / 1k tokens. ~41% token cost reduction. Net savings depend on routing + fallbacks.

alex: product constraint: want >=30% cost reduction and fidelity loss <=1pp on helpdesk slice. Looks close but a hair over fidelity loss. Thoughts on mitigation?

jordan: hybrid routing seems obvious — keep fp16 for short/helpdesk flows or high-confidence predictions, route everything else to int8. Also consider small calibration or light FT on the legal/rare slices.

maya: I ran a tiny routing sim: threshold by prompt length 512 tokens. With that rule we get ~28% cost reduction and helpdesk overall fidelity loss ~0.2pp (weighted by request distribution). The legal slice still shows ~3pp drop — needs special handling.

maya: Config snippet (very small) —

```
# routing rule example (pseudo)
route_request(req):
  if req.slice == 'legal' or req.metadata.flagged_sensitive:
    return 'fp16-argus'
  if req.prompt_length < 512:
    return 'fp16-argus'
  return 'int8-argus'
```

olivia: nice. For GTN handoff we need a mini scorecard: include per-slice fidelity delta, p95 latency, and per-1k token unit price. Can you produce that table?

maya: will do a compact scorecard tomorrow AM. Quick note: one edgecase — a handful of multi-step clarifying dialogs (stateful) show longer-term drift in int8; KV-cache behavior seems slightly noisier. Might need a tiny KV-cache warmstart tweak.

jordan: ops ask: canary this behind a 1% traffic gate with shadow logging for the legal slice?

deploy-bot: canary-deploy created: canary-id cny-20260301-12 (traffic 1%, shadow logging enabled for slices: legal, finance)

sam: next steps: maya to produce the mini scorecard + routing recommendation, olivia will draft the GTN note (cost vs fidelity), alex to confirm product constraints, jordan/ops to schedule canary metrics. I'll collate and push to the short-form doc. :thumbsup:

maya: ok — I'll post the scorecard here and attach the raw runs. Also adding a short synthetic augmentation suggestion for the legal slice (few-shot examples + targeted eval).

olivia: thanks — if scorecard shows legal still bad, recommend holdback for that slice and a human-in-loop for 2 weeks.

maya: noted. will flag in the scorecard.

alex: thanks all. This path seems promising — great job on the quick scout.

jordan: :rocket:
